Faq.faq1q: How do I submit a letter application?
Faq.faq1a: You can submit letters via a registered resident account on this website. Choose the letter type, fill the form, upload the required documents, then submit. Our team will process it.
Faq.faq2q: How long does letter verification take?
Faq.faq2a: Verification usually takes 1×24 working hours. You can track progress on the Track Application page using your letter number.
Faq.faq3q: Is there a fee to submit a letter on the website?
Faq.faq3a: Submitting via the website is free. Some letters may incur administrative fees as stated clearly on the form.
Faq.faq4q: How do I know if my letter is ready?
Faq.faq4a: You will receive an email notification, and you can check the status directly in Your Account. Completed letters are ready to download or pick up at the village office.
Faq.faq5q: What do I need to prepare for an application?
Faq.faq5a: Prepare required documents (usually a photo, ID, and supporting documents) and make sure all form fields are filled correctly.
Faq.faq6q: Can I cancel a submission that has been sent?
Faq.faq6a: Verified submissions cannot be cancelled. If still pending, contact the admin via WhatsApp.
Faq.faq7q: Is an account required to submit a letter?
Faq.faq7a: Yes, a registered resident account is required so that letter applications and complaints are saved and can be tracked via the Account page. Registration is free and only needs your NIK.
Faq.faq8q: I forgot the email I used to register, what should I do?
Faq.faq8a: For this development phase (mock), please contact the village admin or register again with a different email. When the official backend is live, account recovery will be available.
Faq.faq9q: What are the village office hours?
Faq.faq9a: The Borong Village Office serves residents Monday–Friday from 08.00–16.00 WITA. Letter services through the website are accessible 24 hours.
Faq.faq10q: Where can I ask for more information?
Faq.faq10a: Please visit the Village Office, contact the numbers in the footer, or use the floating WhatsApp help button in the bottom-right corner.
